note: BLOCKED (response-data defect, determinate; retry test NO). data/christiannationalism_davis2021.R has an off-by-one: it sets items<-names(x)[-1] and then, looping i in 2:ncol(x), pairs data column x[,i] with label items[i] = names(x)[i+1]. So every live item code names the NEXT source column and the last column is coded with the literal string 'NA'. Source small-relig.tab (Dataverse GUSJEI fileId 5153037, CC0) column order: MOTHERLODEID, xiannation, xianvalues, pubreligion, godsplan, prayer, churchstate. Confirmed against live data (item_stats.R, n=1378 per item) by floor/ceiling counts, which match exactly: live xianvalues 40.2%/11.1% = source xiannation 554/153 of 1378; live pubreligion 29.0/14.3 = source xianvalues 400/197; live godsplan 12.4/20.7 = source pubreligion 171/285; live prayer 25.6/16.1 = source godsplan 353/222; live churchstate 16.1/28.1 = source prayer 222/387; live 'NA' 34.9/8.0 = source churchstate 481/110. The xiannation item is absent from the live table under its own name. Five of six codes are self-describing and would contradict any correctly mapped text, and the sixth is the string 'NA', which most readers coerce to missing, so the text cannot be attached to the codes without shipping a table that misleads a reader. Fix: in the processing script use items[i-1] (or names(x)[i]) and re-upload the response table; codes then become xiannation, xianvalues, pubreligion, godsplan, prayer, churchstate. After that the extraction is trivial and exempt-grade: the deposit's own xn-final-syntax.do (fileId 6317161) quotes all six items against these exact variable names, e.g. '(1) Please rate the extent to which you agree or disagree with the following statements: The federal government should declare the United States as a Christian nation. (MP12A)'; churchstate is stored reverse-coded (recode 1=5 2=4 8=3 3=2 4=1), the others as 1..5 with Undecided (BRS code 8) at 3. Would an unchanged retry right now plausibly produce a different result? NO -- only a corrected response table changes it.
